About Us
"SVCE is Under Council For Social Development Trust"
PRINCIPAL
Prof. Dr. K. Chandrasekhar Reddy
M.Tech., Ph.D.
Email:
principal@svce.edu.in
Prof. Dr. K. Chandrasekhar Reddy — a builder of excellence in every sense — with over 32 years of combined academic and industry experience brings to the role of Principal, and something rare in academic leadership: the mind of a researcher, the hands of a practitioner, and the heart of a mentor. His academic journey, rooted in the engineering traditions of S.V. University and the National Institute of Engineering, Mysore, and culminating in a Ph.D. from S.V University, Tirupati, is the story of a professional who has never stopped building — structures, students, or institutions.
A prolific researcher with over 100 publications in SCIE, Scopus, and WOS indexed journals, five patents, and a published textbook to his credit, Dr. Reddy has equally invested in people — guiding over 50 M.Tech. scholars and doctoral researchers through the demands of original research. His prior 15 years of experience as a Principal and as a NAAC assessor gives him a seasoned understanding of what it takes to lead an institution toward academic and research excellence.
A Senior Member of IEEE, a Fellow of the Institution of Engineers (India), and recipient of the ISTE National level best  Principal Award and JNTUA University best Principal Award, Dr. Reddy arrives at S.V. College of Engineering with a clear sense of purpose — to ensure that every student who walks through these doors leaves equipped not just with a degree, but with the capability to make a lasting mark on the world.
VISION & MISSION
VISION
To be a centre of excellence focusing on high quality technical education, research and technical services with global leadership competence to succeed in employment and higher education with ethical, social, entrepreneurial aspects updating to the real time requirements.
MISSION
M1 -
To impart high quality technical education by providing the state-of-the art infrastructure, core instruction.
M2 -
Advanced research and technical consultancy services with qualified and senior faculty.
M3-
To prepare the students professionally deft and intellectually adept possessing excellent skill, knowledge and behavior with global competence
GOVERNING BODY
Dear Students and Parents,
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to our SV Colleges family.
"We cannot always build the future for our youth, but we can build our youth for the future."
Franklin D. Roosevelt
These words by Franklin D. Roosevelt perfectly describe our aim at SV Colleges. Beyond providing a sound education, we wish to provide our students a holistic learning experience for life. Our aim is to teach students to LEARN, not just STUDY. Hence, we strive to travel beyond the boundaries of mere books. We have realized that the future is abstract and unknown but the youth in our hands are real and can be moulded.
Having students from different parts of the country, I sincerely consider it as our priority to make the students feel right at home. We strive to provide a unique educational experience for students by devoting all our efforts to our mission, insight, and culture. It is our fervent hope that the years that you spend in SV Colleges would enable you to equip with leadership and managerial skills. The knowledge that you will gain, the fine qualities that you will imbibe and the technical skills that you will learn to apply will be your major contribution to your parents, to society, and to the nation.
It is with great pride that I serve as the Chairman of SV Colleges and I believe in the education we offer just as I believe in our faculty and our students. I once again welcome you to our SV Colleges family and assure the best of the education to our students.
"You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great."
